aluratek.status: Original PNG embedded unchanged in an SVG viewBox cropped to its nontransparent bounds, for optical sizing.

aten.status: Official 1010×384 JPEG embedded unchanged with viewBox crop; replaces low resolution artwork. Current SVG embeds its bitmap and derives transparency with an SVG filter.

uprd.status: Approximate vector recreation explicitly requested by Brady; referenced the clearer UPRD wordmark in his archived Radius Digital print ad. Custom paths, no font dependency. This is a reconstruction, not recovered master artwork.

treatment: Nineteen artwork tiles in alphabetical order, with individually tuned optical dimensions and centered partial rows. SVG wrappers embed their source bitmaps; separate source copies are not required. UPRD is an approximate custom vector reconstruction.

lotus-oc.status: official current artwork; Lotus is explicitly labeled as the dealership engagement Current SVG embeds its bitmap and derives transparency with an SVG filter.

freespira.status: Original transparent PNG supplied by Brady; grouped with PA Health Sciences as one relationship.

uci.status: Official primary wordmark; one tile represents UC Irvine and UCI Athletics experience.
